confidence_note: A fake device, not a real one. Its wire format is deliberately unlike WHOOP (0x5A start byte = decimal 90, big-endian length counting the payload only, a single CRC-8 trailer, no header CRC, no padding), described here as a custom frame spec now that ADR-012 made framing manifest data. The framing is core-handled through this spec; the stateful delta decode and the learned anchor are what fall to the mock codec. It declares HeartRate only, no RrInterval, so Milestone 3 can prove capability negotiation hides recovery on a device without RR. See connectors/mock/FORMAT.md.
